description: Civil Aviation (Imposition of Charges for Aerodrome Facilities) Regulations No.1 of 2025
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - In terms of the provisions of the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka Act No. 34 of 2002, all the properties belonging to the Department of Civil Aviation have been transferred to the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka. Accordingly, the relevant Orders for the transfer of the Bandaranaike International Airport, Ratmalana Airport, Jaffna International Airport and Batticaloa International Airport to the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka have been published through Gazette Notifications. Further, as per the provisions of the Civil Aviation Act No. 14 of 2010, Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited has been appointed as the statutory service provider for the development, operation and maintenance of the airports. Accordingly, the Civil Aviation (Imposition of Charges for Aerodrome Facilities) Regulations No.1 of 2025, have been imposed by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2422/38 dated 2025‑02‑06, pertaining to the payment of an annual nominal fee by Airport and Aviation Services (Sri Lanka) (Private) Limited for the use of the said airports vested with the Civil Aviation Authority of Sri Lanka. The proposal made by the Minister to present the said Regulations in Parliament, was approved by the Cabinet.
